name: Relationship Propagates First
statement: Relationship propagates first. Motion is a resolved description of that propagation.

name: One-Object No-Absolute-Vector
statement: One object in the admitted unbounded environment does not by itself earn an absolute propagation vector.

name: Two Objects Earn Relational State
statement: A second distinguishable object creates a nontrivial pairwise relational domain without requiring absolute coordinates.

name: Common-Mode Relational Invariance
statement: Common ambient/field occupancy update may preserve pairwise relational state and therefore yields no relative propagation.

name: Vector Is Downstream
statement: The propagation morphism is prior to its vector representation; the vector appears only after Resolution/readout geometry supplies directed displacement structure.

name: Inheritance/Propagation Split
statement: Inheritance closes identity; propagation updates relational occupancy.

name: Propagation Mode Split
statement: Fixed-context propagation is Transport; context-changing propagation is Transduction.
